clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell's ruined chapel, Shadow Priest Sarvis guides the newly awakened Forsaken. He gives them purpose and directs them against mindless undead and local threats.

Shadow Priest Sarvis guides Forsaken who have just risen from their graves in Deathknell. Their awakening can be jarring and horrific, and some lose their minds to frenzy or despair. Sarvis gives the newly risen a purpose. He sends them to put down the mindless corpses roaming the cemetery and secure Deathknell's borders against the Scourge.

Shadow Priest Sarvis also directs Deathknell's defenses against threats in Tirisfal Glades. Scourge forces probe the town's perimeter, and Sarvis sends novices to gather vital intelligence and face trials of arms. The Forsaken must hold Deathknell against those forces.
